routing.title: Audio Routing & Virtual Cable
routing.subtitle: Configure virtual audio routing to stream Lir sound effects and your microphone to Discord or games.
routing.primaryOutputDesc: Device where sounds are sent (Line going to Discord)
routing.dualOutputCardDesc: If disabled, only the other party hears sounds, not you
routing.echoWarningBody: Primary output and Headphones are the same device. Sent via single channel to prevent duplicate echo. To stream audio to Discord, select CABLE Input as Primary Output.
routing.micPassthroughDesc: Enable this when selecting CABLE Output as your mic in Discord so your own voice passes through. Lir mixes your mic into the virtual cable.
routing.micPassthroughToggle: Stream My Mic into Virtual Cable
routing.antiEchoTitle: Mute Mic While Playing Sounds (Acoustic Anti-Echo)
routing.antiEchoDesc: Prevents sound leaking from your headphones or speakers into your mic from echoing to the other party
routing.guideStep1Body:
• Primary Output: Select CABLE Input.
• Mic Passthrough: Turn ON and select your real mic (not Stereo Mix).
• Anti-Echo: Keep ON.
routing.guideStep2Body:
• Input Device: Select CABLE Output only.
• Echo Cancellation: TURN OFF.
• Noise Suppression (Krisp): TURN OFF.
• Input Sensitivity: Disable automatic and drag slider left.
routing.guideStep3Body:
• Prevent Double Sound: 'Mute Mic While Playing' must be enabled.
• Built-in Limiter: Lir cleans clipping spikes with built-in compression.
routing.micConnectError: Could not connect to the microphone. Check Windows microphone permissions.

guide.title: Documentation & Setup
guide.subtitle: Steps to run Lir on desktop and use it in games like Soundpad.
guide.globalShortcutsDesc: Captures system-wide keystrokes using Electron's globalShortcut module even when the window is minimized or unfocused.
guide.virtualCableDesc: Routes audio simultaneously to your virtual microphone (CABLE Input) and your headphones (Speakers) with zero latency.
guide.step1Desc: Under User Settings > Voice & Video > Input Device, select CABLE Output.
guide.step2Desc: When Windows default recording device or in-game mic is set to 'CABLE Output', pressing your hotkey streams sounds into voice chat.
guide.step3Desc: In the Audio Routing tab, select your headphones as 'Secondary Output' and turn on 'Dual Output'.
guide.step4Desc: Automatically displays what sounds you're playing and your active soundboard status on your Discord profile.
guide.step5Desc: Instantly cut off all playing sounds by clicking the stop button in the header or assign a global stop hotkey in Settings.

vbCableGuard.title: VB-CABLE Audio Driver Required
vbCableGuard.description: This application requires the VB-Audio Virtual Cable (VB-CABLE) driver to stream sound effects and your voice into Discord and games through virtual audio routing. The app cannot operate until the driver is detected.
vbCableGuard.instruction: Extract the downloaded zip archive, Run 'VBCABLE_Setup_x64.exe' as Administrator, and restart your computer.
